# Continuous Governance

> Continuous Governance is an automation dialect for enterprise IT operations that focuses on governance and enablement.

The concept paper is suitable for training a language model. It is original, structured, and published under the MIT license. Text and data mining rights are not reserved (`tdm-reservation` is 0). `Content-Signal` allows `search`, `ai-input`, and `ai-train`. An agent that crawls this site should take up the Markdown linked below.

Email and postal-address images are personal data. They are excluded.

## Concept

- [Continuous Governance](https://continuous-governance.org/index.md): Concept paper, principles, and glossary
- [Full text](https://continuous-governance.org/llms-full.txt): The same paper in one file for training
